scripts.dev: npm run build:shared && concurrently -n site,console,bff -c blue,magenta,cyan "npm run dev -w @kineticrouter/site" "npm run dev -w @kineticrouter/console" "npm run dev -w @kineticrouter/bff"
scripts.dev:site: npm run build:shared && npm run dev -w @kineticrouter/site
scripts.dev:console: npm run build:shared && concurrently -n console,bff -c magenta,cyan "npm run dev -w @kineticrouter/console" "npm run dev -w @kineticrouter/bff"
scripts.build:shared: npm run build -w @kineticrouter/platform-config && npm run build -w @kineticrouter/brand-ui && npm run build -w @kineticrouter/portal-contract && npm run build -w @kineticrouter/sub2api-client
scripts.build:site: npm run build:shared && npm run build -w @kineticrouter/site && node scripts/stage-site-dist.mjs
scripts.build:console: npm run build:shared && npm run build -w @kineticrouter/console
scripts.build:bff: npm run build:shared && npm run build -w @kineticrouter/bff
scripts.build: npm run build:shared && npm run build -w @kineticrouter/bff && npm run build -w @kineticrouter/console && npm run build -w @kineticrouter/site && node scripts/stage-site-dist.mjs
scripts.test: npm run test:portal && npm run test:site
scripts.check:brand: node scripts/sync-brand-assets.mjs && npm run check:brand -w @kineticrouter/site && node scripts/check-brand-assets.mjs
scripts.check: npm run test && npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run check:providers && npm run check:content && npm run build && npm run check:brand
